summary: Iteration 38 — Admin Reviews redesign (backend + E2E UI), mobile shopping flow smoke test (home → product → cart drawer → checkout), and A2HS first-visit tip on iPhone UA. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases passed covering list/filter/counts, create, PATCH visible/reply, PUT edit, bulk show/hide/delete, auth guards (missing Bearer and missing X-Admin-Token both rejected). Frontend admin E2E: login via /admin/login (password + TOTP) worked, 評價管理 page loads with 3 stat cards (total=464, hidden, no_reply=312), table renders rows, load-more, search filter, rating filter (30 results for 5★), visible filter, create → reply → toggle visible → edit → bulk hide/show → delete all exercised. Mobile shopping flow on 390×844: product detail opens, spec select, product-reviews tab visible, add-to-cart opens CartDrawer, qty +, cart-checkout-btn navigates to /checkout (login gate expected), body position style reset after sheet close (no scroll lock leak), 0 console errors / 0 page errors across the flow. A2HS tip appears after ~4s on iPhone UA, open button opens dialog and dismisses tip, reload keeps it dismissed via localStorage, clearing a2hs_tip_until re-shows it, close button also dismisses.

issues: React hydration warning in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Not from ReviewsAdmin (its <option> contents are plain text) — likely from another admin page's <select>. Non-blocking but should be investigated.

action_items: (Optional) Hunt down the admin <select> that renders <span> inside <option> to silence the React 19 hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_list_reviews.no_reply counter correctly excludes empty-content rows ({"content": {"$ne": ""}}).
admin_patch_review sets replied_at = now_iso() on reply, '' when cleared — good.
admin_bulk_reviews validates action whitelist {show, hide, delete}; returns 400 on invalid.
ReviewsAdmin.jsx state is correctly reset to page 1 on filter change (setShown(PAGE) via effect).
A2HSTip.jsx reads navigator.userAgent / standalone at module scope — correct for client bundle; non-iOS/non-Android UA skips cleanly.
iosViewportFix.js attaches listeners only when isIOS === true, confirming no side effects on non-iOS UA (per request).
useScrollLock.reconcile restores body.position/top/width to saved values and scrollTo(savedScrollY) after last lock releases — verified in E2E: body style is empty after CartDrawer closes.
